reviews.text: Sign-in request aren’t working please fix

reviews.title: I wish I could search effectively
reviews.text: Just the exact words in the subject would be helpful

reviews.title: Unwanted banners appearing and won’t clear
reviews.text: Since the latest update, there are banners I can’t clear including a grey bar asking me to log into a different account, and a blue banner with ‘delete’ and ‘undo’ printed but it doesn’t respond to anything. It covers over my email text and interferes with sending/reading messages. Please fix!

reviews.title: Unusable on iPhone
reviews.text: Literally can’t access your own sent emails. Why even offer this as an app, it is completely unusable

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Search function is ABYSMAL. Keywords are irrelevant. You will never find exactly what you want due to some weird filter. Hides part of your email chain??? Both the web and mobile apps are unusable.

reviews.title: Don’t close out of the app when you send an email
reviews.text: I closed out of the app once I sent an email AND IT DIDNT SEND THE EMAIL UNTIL I OPENED BACK INTO THE APP. This has happened countless times and is terrible for work. 0/5 stars if the product can’t even work.

reviews.title: Broken!
reviews.text: I cannot login.  I have tried resetting everything.  It just tells me to get a number from the authenticator.  But the authenticator wants me to login.  For some reason, I cannot log into my Microsoft account at all.  I have tried calling for Support, but your Automated AI is absolutely no help. There is no option to interact with it to actually get help. It just spews out useless information to go to the website that I’ve already been to. That is no help.

reviews.title: Genuinely how is it this bad?
reviews.text: I wish I could give it 0 stars. Buggy, doesn’t load new mail. Sorting makes no sense.

reviews.title: Deletes the wrong message
reviews.text: This is unreliable, occasionally it deletes the wrong message, not the one I was reading - sometimes I'll be reading a message, tap the delete icon, the message closes but the message I just deleted is still in the Inbox. I'll look in the Deleted folder and the message next to it was deleted! And if the developers are too lazy to add details to the What's New change log, I'll be too lazy to give you an actual star rating, 1 star (you're welcome). A recent change moved the message toolbar from the bottom right to the left, so annoying.

reviews.title: Frequently will not work
reviews.text: Often gets stuck with loading circle when trying to reply to emails and also rarely is able to open attachments (small 40kb attachments)

reviews.title: Suddenly huge amount of obvious spam
reviews.text:
Adding an update. I’m continuing to get AI-created spam offering services that are phishing from clearly suspicious domains. MS has created the tools to cause this and needs to now create the tools to filter it. 
Original Please implement a selection for degree of spam filtration or implement a better algorithm. When odd text font or clearly bad servers are in play MS should have the ability to filter vs making users report spam.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: This app regularly does NOT notify you of new email. Super frustrating, especially if it is important and the sender is awaiting a response. Nice job Microsoft, thought you could do better than this.

reviews.title: Can’t create new mail???!!!
reviews.text: I even updated this trash and it’s still giving me the error “Something went wrong…” blah blah blah. It’s Microsoft after lol. No wonder it’s not working. This is why I use Gmail. So tired of Microsoft. Get your app working already!
